name: Goroomgo Nalanda Guest House
why_nakshiq: 40 rooms on the Bihar Sharif–Rajgir Road in Nalanda 803111, listed by Tripadvisor at 2.2 km from the ASI ruins and 5 km from the Hiuen Tsang Memorial. Goroomgo runs the property as a budget chain — clean, predictable, AC, free Wi-Fi, on-site restaurant. The honest budget pick if you want to overnight in Nalanda proper instead of pulling back to Rajgir.

name: Hotel Abhilasha
why_nakshiq: 200 metres from the Jal Mandir gate, on AH-20 (Patna–Ranchi Road) at Pawapuri More. The closest commercial bookable inventory to the lotus-tank temple — AC rooms, in-house restaurant doing tandoori chicken and South Indian breakfast, 24-hour front desk. The dharamshalas are closer; this is the closest hotel a non-Jain pilgrim can comfortably book.

name: The Vaishali Residency
why_nakshiq: 80 rooms on Vishwa Shanti Stupa Road in Basarh — 300 metres from the Buddha Samyak Darshan Museum + Relic Stupa and a 6-minute drive from the Ashokan Pillar at Kolhua. Department of Tourism Bihar–recognised, three floors, AC, hot water (when the power holds), and a multi-cuisine restaurant. The closest mid-tier hotel to Vaishali's two anchor monuments.

name: Hotel Amrapali Vihar
why_nakshiq: Private guesthouse on the Main Road in Chakramdas, near the Vaishali Museum and the Vishwa Shanti Stupa — running for over a decade with 3.8/5 across 63 Justdial reviews. AC and non-AC rooms, Indian-Chinese kitchen, transport on order. The straightforward budget alternative if BSTDC's Ambapali Vihar is full or its tariff feels stiff.
